title: Top, then drop
description: An upswing takes price to the 28,656 high (23 Mar 15:00). Everything after it is the incomplete leg, which holds two downswings: the 27,961 low (18:00) bounces to 28,428 and is closed below on 24 Mar 11:00 (27,637); that close is the next low, which bounces to 28,052 and is closed below at 17:00 (27,634).
